title: 人工晶状体临床试验
notes: Previously used during application development; permanently excluded from frozen final testing. Protocol-to-reference-SAP version alignment still needs human confirmation.

title: Educational Videos to Address Racial Disparities in Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator Therapy Via Innovative Designs
notes: Protocol date is explicitly cited by SAP v1. Fully public pair with a concise binary primary endpoint and a documented change from two co-primary comparisons to one primary comparison.

title: Impact of Premedication on Anxiety
notes: Exact public protocol-CRF-SAP triplet. SAP explicitly cites protocol v2.0 and CRF v1.4. Retained as an auxiliary protocol_crf and evidence-traceability case because the study is observational.

title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Microbiome Dynamics of SER-287 in Subjects With Mild-to-Moderate Ulcerative Colitis
notes: SAP explicitly cites final protocol amendment 3 dated 2016-10-10. The primary microbiome analysis is delegated to a separate unavailable plan, so this is a deliberate missing-document challenge rather than a clean final-test case.

title: Anemia Studies in Chronic Kidney Disease: Erythropoiesis Via a Novel Prolyl Hydroxylase Inhibitor Daprodustat-Dialysis
notes: SAP explicitly cites protocol amendment 5 dated 2020-07-30. High-difficulty candidate covering co-primary non-inferiority, MACE time-to-event analysis, estimands, gatekeeping, and multiplicity.

title: A Randomized Trial in 2 Parts Evaluating Dasiglucagon in Children With Congenital Hyperinsulinism
notes: SAP final v3.0 explicitly cites protocol ZP4207-17103 final v14.0 for Germany and v13.0 elsewhere, both dated 2021-06-04. Small-sample crossover case with an explicit treatment-policy estimand and protocol-level missing-data rules.

title: Blood Pressure Control in Hypertensive Smokers
notes: The protocol and three-page Data Analytic Plan share the exact NCT identifier, study title, and 2021-09-20 approval date. Retained as a difficult historical behavioral trial with abstinence-conditioned primary analyses and unresolved multiplicity details.

title: Randomized, Controlled Dietary Treatment Study of Pediatric NAFLD
notes: Protocol v7.0 and the SAP have the same exact title and date, 2016-02-10. Small pediatric dietary RCT with MRI-PDFF, longitudinal secondary analyses, and an explicit MAR strategy.

title: Novel Treatments for Endometriosis (NOTE): Dopamine Receptor Agonist Therapy for Pain Relief in Women Suffering from Endometriosis Pilot Study
notes: IRB protocol and SAP share the exact NCT identifier, full title, and 2019-06-11 date. Deliberately retained as a very small estimation-focused pilot in which neither superiority nor equivalence should be claimed.

title: Safety and Therapeutic Efficacy of the Broadly Neutralizing HIV-1 Specific Monoclonal Antibody VRC01 during Analytic Treatment Interruption in Patients who Initiated Antiretroviral Therapy During Early Acute HIV Infection
notes: Protocol and SAP are both RV397/WRAIR #2180/SEARCH024 version 2.0 dated 2016-12-01. High-value small-sample case using exact unconditional and exact log-rank tests.

title: GORE HELEX/CARDIOFORM Septal Occluder and Antiplatelet Medical Management for Reduction of Recurrent Stroke or Imaging-Confirmed TIA in Patients with Patent Foramen Ovale
notes: Protocol amendment 3 and SAP revision 1 share protocol HLX 06-03 and the exact date 2016-01-15. Device trial with co-primary recurrent-event and MRI brain-infarct endpoints.

title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Imsidolimab in Adult Subjects with Generalized Pustular Psoriasis
notes: Protocol and SAP share ANB019-301, NCT05352893, and the exact date 2022-12-09. Includes an explicit estimand, MI/MNAR sensitivity analyses, fixed-sequence multiplicity, and blinded sample-size re-estimation.

title: Woebot for Substance Use Disorders Phase 2 RCT: Digitally Delivered Intervention for Reducing Problematic Substance Use
notes: Protocol and two-page SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2023-03-17. Digital intervention case with retention weighting, arm-specific adherence definitions, and unresolved multiplicity details.

title: A Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Effects of Chenodeoxycholic Acid in Adult and Pediatric Patients with Cerebrotendinous Xanthomatosis (RESTORE)
notes: SAP v2.0 dated 2023-07-17 explicitly cites protocol Cheno-CTX-301 Amendment 6 dated 2023-04-04. Rare-disease crossover case with rescue handling, paired analyses, Holm-Bonferroni testing, and a separate pediatric cohort.

title: Wellness Programs for Brain-Injured Individuals
notes: Protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2019-04-05. Pilot-specific descriptive analysis is distinguished from an illustrative mixed model for a future efficacy study.

title: Transcriptomic Signatures of Influenza Vaccine Responses
notes: Protocol version 7 and the SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2019-05-19. The concise SAP defines the Day 28 HAI comparison and laboratory-processing rules; broader protocol analyses remain exploratory or require confirmation.

title: A Multicenter Single-arm Extension Study to Characterize the Long-term Safety of Cinacalcet Hydrochloride in the Treatment of Secondary Hyperparathyroidism in Pediatric Subjects With Chronic Kidney Disease on Dialysis
notes: SAP v2.0 explicitly cites protocol Amendment 3 dated 2016-03-16. The public protocol bundle contains that complete amendment plus a 2016-06-01 superseding amendment limited to administrative/typographical corrections in safety thresholds. Descriptive pediatric extension with parent-study combined analyses and detailed missing-data sensitivity methods.

title: A Phase III, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of VM202 to Treat Chronic Nonhealing Foot Ulcers in Diabetic Patients with Concomitant Peripheral Arterial Disease
notes: Protocol VMNHU-003 Version I and SAP Version E both identify NCT02563522 and 2020-02-04. The SAP documents early termination, a single ITT primary wound-closure endpoint, exact testing, multiple sensitivity populations, repeated measures, and descriptive safety.

title: Renal Safety of Bowel Preparation With Polyethylene Glycol for Outpatient Colonoscopy: an Observational Prospective Study
notes: The concise public protocol and separate statistical-analysis document share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2015-11-18. Retained as an auxiliary observational safety case; absent population, missing-data, multiplicity, and success rules remain explicit confirmation requirements.

title: Patient Targeted Upper Extremity Rehabilitation After Stroke
notes: Protocol and SAP both identify NCT01819506, Version 4.0, and 2016-08-01. The protocol provides the randomized severity-stratified rehabilitation design; the later analysis detail in the independent SAP is represented as confirmed decisions rather than protocol-only facts.

title: Biobehavioral Pathways Underlying Alcohol Use and Health
notes: The independent protocol and SAP share the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2023-05-25 date. The two cohorts are defined by clinical status rather than randomized treatment assignment, and all participants receive the intervention.

title: Skeletal Muscle Atrophy and Dysfunction Following Total Knee Arthroplasty
notes: The protocol and separate two-page prospective analysis plan share the exact title, NCT identifier, and date 2022-03-23. The pair covers a covariate-adaptive randomized NMES comparison with mechanistic muscle outcomes.

title: Multicenter Randomized Active-controlled Study to Investigate Efficacy & Safety of IV FCM in Pediatric Patients With IDA
notes: SAP v2.0 dated 2020-07-15 explicitly cites protocol 1VIT17044 Administrative Change 1 dated 2019-09-26, which is present in the public bundle. Protocol-to-SAP changes in analysis population, imputation, laboratory grading, and subgroup coverage are kept as confirmed decisions or confirmation items.
